messages:
alex: Heads-up: planning to unfreeze/unpin runtime variant v2.9-quantpatch for 'batch-llong' cohort during the maintenance window tomorrow 01:00-03:00 UTC. This includes kernel fixes + small heap reclaim tweak. Any known compatibility gotchas? :wave:

nate: Do we have SDK version constraints? Last time the quantpatch interacted weird with SDK 1.3.x; we pinned SDK to 1.4.0 for that cohort. If we don't enforce SDK >=1.4.1, we should at least canary.

tori: Noted. Ops: propose canary plan -> 02:00 start, 2 hosts eu-central, 0.5% traffic, smoke evals for 15m. Ramp to 10% at 02:20 if green, 100% by 02:50. Rollback triggers: error-rate + stddev latency >30% over baseline for 10m, or OOM observed.

deploybot: [auto] Received request: `unfreeze runtime v2.9-quantpatch -> cohort batch-llong`. Scheduling tentative job: id uf-1717771234. Preflight checks enabled: `sdk-guard`, `canary-smoke`, `kv-warmup`.

alex: FYI: models in this cohort include quant-v2 and quant-v3b. quant-v3b had a small hallucination regression in prior runtime 2.8 -> ensure eval set includes the hallucination prompts.

nate: I'll add that prompt set and a quick diff script. Also adding a compatibility guard: deploybot should abort if any host reports SDK <=1.4.0.

tori: Ops checklist (short):
- enable kv-cache warmup script before canary (runbook attached)
- set canary alert thresholds in SLO dashboard
- dry-run deploy on staging 20:30 UTC tonight

obs-bot: Baseline snapshot: https://internal/obs/dashboards/cohort-batch-llong baseline taken 2024-06-26T23:00Z. Alert ids: cohort-latency, cohort-err-rate, kv-coldstart

alex: I'll update the release notes: include rollback procedure, links to dashboard, and contact list (ops oncall + release owner). One ask: if deploybot aborts during phase 1, can it automatically open a rollback ticket and tag oncall?

deploybot: Yes. Configured to create incident stub with tags `runtime-unfreeze` + cohort. Will ping `@ops-oncall` and post status updates here.

nate: ack (compat checks + evals)

tori: ack (canary/runbook/alerts)

alex: ack (release notes + incident hooks). Ready to flip to "ready for window" after staging dry-run completes.
